oneclickpdf.problem_solved_original: Many online PDF sites upload every file to their servers, even to merge two documents or add a signature, and cap free use unless you pay for a plan. OneClickPDF does most PDF jobs in your own browser, free and without an account, and is upfront about the few that need to go online.
